notes.title: Specials skills showcase
notes.content:
Tired of shooting your usual projectiles? We got you, use your special power to evaporate any enemy on screen! (well, except bosses for weird reasons)

Each character's special will change according to their weapon. From Energy Ball to Magnet Bomb or Spartan Crusher there is a lot of specials to discover but take a glimpse at some character's specials :

 Agni's Skull Slap
 Invoke a giant skeleton to gently SLAP your enemy into the void. This should do it nicely.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/c9599efda533bf5f81059c6c83c008b64a4cd287.gif


 Colden's Dragon's Breath
 Kindly ask a dragon to clean your screen with a little breath of fire. Can't be bad right?

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/50e818767f0e132998293a378264f049166046e2.gif


 Luken's Bat Tornado
 Nananana Lukeeen! Make use of the bats surrounding you and blow of your enemies with a bat tornado!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/b976e2d474b1eea997dc5c714ea0ddfb9a71e665.gif

If this peaked your interest you can follow and whishlist Cassiodora:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1708550/Cassiodora/

notes.title: Ranking and scores
notes.content:
Challenge your friends in Cassiodora!

Cassiodora features score points and a ranking system from F to S determined at the end of each level. There are different ways to get the most point:
- Defeat enemies
- Don't lose life points
- Make the biggest combo hit
- Finish a level quickly

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/665d65af40d64036ad9589c27880d9759e499203.gif

There is a few more ways to get more points but we'll let you discover them! Meanwhile, you can follow and wishlist Cassiodora to get all the latest news here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1708550/Cassiodora/

notes.title: Difficulty levels
notes.content:
With Cassiodora we wanted to create a game accessible to all players. In addition to the standard difficulty levels (easy, normal, hard), we will have an accessibility level available where the player will be able to enjoy the game without worrying about the punishment for making mistakes, regardless of their age or familiarity with games. On the other hand, the game can be quite challenging for those willing to face the challenge.

4 difficulty levels:

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/cd4dd62c7bf84fc1af17c176cebb36a7a5f3dbbf.gif


 Apprentice
 This is an accessibility level, not punitive, even if you die the game does not give you a game over, you can just keep playing without having to worry about that. This is indicated to new players or younger kids.


 Squire
 This is the Easy mode, you have more health, you can find health crystals during the levels to restore you lost crystals and the bosses have less health. Your health is also restored between some Bosses phases.


 Warrior
 This is the Normal mode, you have the standard amount of health and a good challenge on fights and puzzles. You also restore health between some Bosses phases.


 Knight
 This is the Hard mode, you have the standard amount of health but bosses have more health and challenges are much harder. You don't restore health between Bosses phases.

As you can see Cassiodora is a game that you will let you play and have fun with your friends and family whatever their skills!

notes.title: Story mode levels
notes.content:
In Cassiodora you will encounter different type of levels during your adventure. They are built around 3 major playstyle:


 Power through levels and defeat every enemy in front of you to get closer and closer to save princess Cassiodora.


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/c7a76780d7a78df647795d572fc3e3584a12855b.gif


 Be chased by gigantic enemies and escape their teeths and claw. But beware, your way out is seeded with troubles. 


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/0add8710a5110e472bfd40fe3316993cc8a4f5c7.gif


 Saving princess Cassiodra will force you to face dangerous bosses. Defeat them and inch closer to the Evil threat menacing the kingdom of Astoria.


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/bfe2b172290503fb87792160d5df52641c34c99d.gif
